terms.gloss: sting, of a bee or wasp

ico.claim: short i in the present; the perfect is īcī
ico.against: Lewis & Short ī̆cĭo, ī̆co, marked common
ico.html: A vowel Lewis & Short marks common is left unmarked. Lewis & Short reports a short present ĭco from Priscian (886 P.) beside a long īcit in Lucr. 3.160 and Plaut. Mil. 2.2.50, and gives the perfect as īcī.

sources: Lewis & Short: acūleus · Lewis & Short: ico
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 141, 144.
